column1: # Kernel.ObjectRecord: Objective contract manifest. Written by `scripts/check-objective-proofs.sh proofs --pin`;
# a removed or changed row needs a line in scripts/gates/objective-contract-changes.txt.

column8: Option Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Option ℕ → Option ℕ → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts

{motive : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePolicy → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePolicy) → t.ctorIdx = 0 → motive Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePolicy.frozen → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePolicy → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePolicy) → t.ctorIdx = 1 → ((authority : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) → (floors : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred) → motive (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePolicy.governed authority floors)) → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal) → t.ctorIdx = 1 → ((leaf : Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf) → motive (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal.lawDenied leaf)) → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal) → t.ctorIdx = 0 → motive Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal.unprojectable → motive t

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (seed : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (leaf : Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitSeed record facts seed = Except.error (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal.lawDenied leaf) → ∃ before after, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts Option.none seed = Option.some (before, after) ∧ record.law.subterm leaf.path = Option.some leaf.clause ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval leaf.clause before after = Bool.false

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (seed : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitSeed record facts seed = Except.ok () ↔ ∃ before after, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts Option.none seed = Option.some (before, after) ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval record.law before after = Bool.true

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (leaf : Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new = Except.error (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal.lawDenied leaf) → ∃ before after, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) ∧ record.effectiveLaw.subterm leaf.path = Option.some leaf.clause ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval leaf.clause before after = Bool.false

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new = Except.ok () ↔ ∃ before after, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval record.effectiveLaw before after = Bool.true

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (payer : Minidregg.Theory.CanonicalResourceKernel.AccountId) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite { id := record.id, pin := record.pin, schemaVersion := record.schemaVersion, law := record.law, upgrade := record.upgrade, continuity := record.continuity, payer := payer } facts old new = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new

∀ (artifacts : List ℕ) (rest : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), new.get Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot = Option.some (-1) → Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf.of (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.all (Minidregg.Pred.objectivePin artifacts :: rest)) old new = Option.some { path := [0], clause := Minidregg.Pred.objectivePin artifacts, before := old.get Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot, after := Option.some (-1) }

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval record.effectiveLaw old new = Bool.true ↔ Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.pinClause record.pin) old new = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval record.law old new = Bool.true

∀ (law : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (leaf : Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.judgeLaw law facts old new = Except.error (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal.lawDenied leaf) → ∃ before after, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) ∧ law.subterm leaf.path = Option.some leaf.clause ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval leaf.clause before after = Bool.false

∀ (law : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.judgeLaw law facts old new = Except.ok () ↔ ∃ before after, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval law before after = Bool.true

∀ (authority authority' : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (floors floors' : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred), (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePolicy.governed authority floors).permits (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePolicy.governed authority' floors') = Bool.true → (∀ floor ∈ floors, floor ∈ floors') ∧ ∀ (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval authority' old new = Bool.true → Minidregg.Pred.eval authority old new = Bool.true

∀ (pin : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), facts.artifact = Option.some pin.value → ∀ (before after : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.pinClause pin) before after = Bool.true

Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.leafOf (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts Option.none) Option.none (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 1)) = Option.some { path := [0], clause := Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.pinClause { value := 7 }, before := Option.some (-1), after := Option.some (-1) } ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.leafOf (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts (Option.some 8)) Option.none (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 1)) = Option.some { path := [0], clause := Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.pinClause { value := 7 }, before := Option.some 8, after := Option.some 8 } ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.accepted (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts (Option.some 7)) Option.none (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 1)) = Bool.true

Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.accepted (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitSeed Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts Option.none) (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 1)) = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.accepted (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts Option.none) Option.none (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 1)) = Bool.false ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.accepted (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitSeed Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethSeedRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts Option.none) (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 5)) = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.leafOf (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitSeed Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethSeedRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts Option.none) (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 6)) = Option.some { path := [], clause := Minidregg.Pred.Pred.eq "state" 5, before := Option.none, after := Option.some 6 }

∀ (authority authority' : Minidregg.Pred.Pred), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.strengthens authority authority' = Bool.true → ∀ (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval authority' old new = Bool.true → Minidregg.Pred.eval authority old new = Bool.true

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), facts.artifact = Option.none → ∀ (before after : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new = Except.error (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal.lawDenied { path := [0], clause := Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.pinClause record.pin, before := before.get Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot, after := Option.some (-1) })

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), facts.artifact = Option.none → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new ≠ Except.ok ()

∀ (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (before after : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) → before.get Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot = Option.some facts.artifactValue ∧ after.get Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot = Option.some facts.artifactValue

∀ (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (before after : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) → ∃ b a, before = { slots := facts.slots ++ b } ∧ after = { slots := facts.slots ++ a }
